027        public AsteroidImpact(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, boolean dealDamage) {
028                this.fleet = fleet;
029                
030                //System.out.println("ADDING IMPACT TO " + fleet.getName() + " " + fleet.getId());
031                
032                Vector2f v = fleet.getVelocity();
033                float angle = Misc.getAngleInDegrees(v);
034                float speed = v.length();
035                if (speed < 10) angle = fleet.getFacing();
036
037                float mult = Misc.getFleetRadiusTerrainEffectMult(fleet);
038                
039                //float arc = 120f;
040                float arc = 120f - 60f * mult; // larger fleets suffer more direct collisions that slow them down more
041                
042                angle += (float) Math.random() * arc - arc/2f;
043                angle += 180f;
044                
045                //if (fleet.getCurrBurnLevel() <= SAFE_BURN_LEVEL || mult <= 0) {
046                if (Misc.isSlowMoving(fleet) || mult <= 0) {
047                        elapsed = DURATION_SECONDS;
048                        dV = new Vector2f();
049                } else if (fleet.isInCurrentLocation()) {
050                        if (dealDamage) {
051                                WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI> targets = new WeightedRandomPicker<FleetMemberAPI>();
052                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : fleet.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
053                                        float w = 1f;
054                                        switch (member.getHullSpec().getHullSize()) {
055                                        case CAPITAL_SHIP: w = 20f; break;
056                                        case CRUISER: w = 10f; break;
057                                        case DESTROYER: w = 5f; break;
058                                        case FRIGATE: w = 1f; break;
059                                        }
060                                        targets.add(member, w);
061                                }
062                                
063                                FleetMemberAPI member = targets.pick();
064                                if (member != null) {
065                                        float damageMult = fleet.getCurrBurnLevel() - Misc.getGoSlowBurnLevel(fleet);
066                                        if (damageMult < 1) damageMult = 1;
067                                        if (Misc.isExtended()) damageMult *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_environmentalDamageMult");
068                                        Misc.applyDamage(member, null, damageMult, true, "asteroid_impact", "Asteroid impact",
069                                                                         true, null, member.getShipName() + " suffers damage from an asteroid impact");
070                                } else {
071                                        dealDamage = false;
072                                }
073                        }
074                        
075                        if (!dealDamage && fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
076                                Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().addMessage("Asteroid impact on drive bubble", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor());
077                        }
078                        
079                        Vector2f test = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocation();
080                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(test, fleet.getLocation());
081                        if (dist < HyperspaceTerrainPlugin.STORM_STRIKE_SOUND_RANGE) {
082//                              float volumeMult = 1f - (dist / HyperspaceTerrainPlugin.STORM_STRIKE_SOUND_RANGE);
083//                              volumeMult = (float) Math.sqrt(volumeMult);
084                                //volumeMult *= 0.75f;
085                                float volumeMult = 0.75f;
086                                volumeMult *= 0.5f + 0.5f * mult;
087                                if (volumeMult > 0) {
088                                        if (dealDamage) {
089                                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("hit_heavy", 1f, 1f * volumeMult, fleet.getLocation(), Misc.ZERO);
090                                        } else {
091                                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("hit_shield_heavy_gun", 1f, 1f * volumeMult, fleet.getLocation(), Misc.ZERO);
092                                        }
093                                }
094                        }
095                        
096//                      if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
097//                              System.out.println("wefwefwef");
098//                      }
099                        //mult = 2f;
100//                      if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
101//                              System.out.println("SPAWNED ---------");
102//                      }
103
104//                      int num = (int) (6f + (float) Math.random() * 5f);
105//                      for (int i = 0; i < num; i++) {
106//                              angle = angle + (float) Math.random() * 30f - 15f;
107//                              float size = 10f + (float) Math.random() * 6f;
108//                              float size = 10f + (float) Math.random() * 6f;
109//                              size = 4f + 4f * (float) Math.random();
110//                              
111//                              AsteroidAPI asteroid = fleet.getContainingLocation().addAsteroid(size);
112//                              asteroid.setFacing((float) Math.random() * 360f);
113//                              Vector2f av = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + 180f);
114//                              av.scale(fleet.getVelocity().length() + (20f + 20f * (float) Math.random()) * mult);
115//                              asteroid.getVelocity().set(av);
116//                              Vector2f al = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + 180f);
117//                              //al.scale(fleet.getRadius() + asteroid.getRadius());
118//                              al.scale(fleet.getRadius());
119//                              Vector2f.add(al, fleet.getLocation(), al);
120//                              asteroid.setLocation(al.x, al.y);
121//                              
122//                              float sign = Math.signum(asteroid.getRotation());
123//                              asteroid.setRotation(sign * (50f + 50f * (float) Math.random()));
124//                              
125//                              Misc.fadeInOutAndExpire(asteroid, 0.2f, 1.5f + 1f * (float) Math.random(), 1f);
126//                      }
127                        
128                        float size = 10f + (float) Math.random() * 6f;
129                        size *= 0.67f;
130                        AsteroidAPI asteroid = fleet.getContainingLocation().addAsteroid(size);
131                        asteroid.setFacing((float) Math.random() * 360f);
132                        Vector2f av = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + 180f);
133                        av.scale(fleet.getVelocity().length() + (20f + 20f * (float) Math.random()) * mult);
134                        asteroid.getVelocity().set(av);
135                        Vector2f al = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle + 180f);
136                        //al.scale(fleet.getRadius() + asteroid.getRadius());
137                        al.scale(fleet.getRadius());
138                        Vector2f.add(al, fleet.getLocation(), al);
139                        asteroid.setLocation(al.x, al.y);
140                        
141                        float sign = Math.signum(asteroid.getRotation());
142                        asteroid.setRotation(sign * (50f + 50f * (float) Math.random()));
143                        
144                        Misc.fadeInOutAndExpire(asteroid, 0.2f, 1f + 1f * (float) Math.random(), 1f);
145                        
146                        //mult = 1f;
147                        Vector2f iv = fleet.getVelocity();
148                        iv = new Vector2f(iv);
149                        iv.scale(0.7f);
150                        float glowSize = 100f + 100f * mult + 50f * (float) Math.random();
151                        Color color = new Color(255, 165, 100, 255);
152                        Misc.addHitGlow(fleet.getContainingLocation(), al, iv, glowSize, color);
153                }
154                
155                dV = Misc.getUnitVectorAtDegreeAngle(angle);
156                
157                float impact = speed * 1f * (0.5f + mult * 0.5f); 
158                dV.scale(impact);
159                dV.scale(1f / DURATION_SECONDS);
160                
161//              if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
162//                      fleet.addFloatingText("Impact!", Misc.getNegativeHighlightColor(), 0.5f);
163//              }
164        }

200        public boolean isDone() {
201                return elapsed >= DURATION_SECONDS;
202        }
